product_one_liner.value: WellnessLiving is an all-in-one business management platform for fitness, wellness, health, and beauty businesses that combines booking, client management, payments, marketing, loyalty programs, and reporting.

founded_year.notes: The company’s own funding announcement says founded in 2013; its LinkedIn company profile instead lists 2012.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog is customer-facing marketing, product news, and business advice; no qualifying engineering blog with two engineer-authored technical posts was identified.

public_docs.notes: Public Help Center with multiple documentation collections and articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The employer publishes an AI Solutions Engineer posting, dated 2026-08-07, for building AI workflows, copilots, agentic systems, and LLM-driven solutions.

model_provider.notes: Explicitly disclosed for the Isaac AI assistant; this does not establish the provider used by CAASI.

compliance_certs.notes: SOC 2 Type 2 report and third-party HIPAA audits are claimed; GDPR is claimed adherence as a processor, not a formal certification. ISO 27001 is attributed to AWS, not WellnessLiving. PCI-DSS scope is described as limited and reliant on merchant processors, rather than a standalone WellnessLiving certification.

value.stage: Minority growth investment and debt financing

last_funding.notes: The announcement describes US$46 million in minority investment led by McCarthy Capital plus US$20 million in CIBC growth financing, explicitly totaling US$66 million for the round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified financing was announced on 2022-08-16, before the 2025-05-09 to 2026-11-09 window; the company funding profile lists no later round.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live employer posting for Outbound Account Executive (SaaS), dated 2026-10-01.

launched_6mo.notes: The 2026-07-28 announcement states general availability of CAASI Chat Agent and CAASI Phone Agent, within the 2026-05-09 to 2026-11-09 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Jay Hedges’s profile lists VP Sales at WellnessLiving beginning July 2026, within the 2025-11-09 to 2026-11-09 window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The AE posting names Salesforce as its CRM. The Zoho CRM Lead posting explicitly describes migrating the sales team from Salesforce to Zoho; it does not establish that the migration is complete.
